text: I've been trying to get through for nearly forty minutes so I'm writing it all down here. My grandson is 10 and his temperature is 39.5. He's got some kind of spots coming up. He's dark skinned so it's not easy to see on his arms or chest, so I've looked at the palms of his hands, the soles of his feet and inside his mouth and his lower eyelids where it's lighter. There's tiny dots there, dark red, almost purple, like pinpricks, and a bigger mark on his foot like a bruise he hasn't got any reason to have. I pressed a glass against them and they did NOT go pale, they stayed exactly the same. I've done what the leaflets say. Now I need someone to actually tell me what to do instead of leaving me on hold.
